description: This PHP file handles the migration process in the vtiger CRM system. It includes permission checks, database connection setups, migration logic for various migration options such as database details, dump files, and altering database details, as well as related validation and execution steps.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: Class responsible for handling the migration operations such as migrating data from old to new database, applying dump files, and modifying database schema.

methods.name: setOldDatabaseParams
methods.description: Sets parameters for the old database connection.

methods.name: setNewDatabaseParams
methods.description: Sets parameters for the new database connection.

methods.name: migrate
methods.description: Performs data migration from source to target database or from dump file.

methods.name: modifyDatabase
methods.description: Modifies the current database schema or data as part of the migration process.
